summary: GrowHub Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq notification letter for non-compliance with the minimum $2.5M stockholders' equity requirement under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). As of December 31, 2025, equity was $2,299,129. The company has until July 10, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, with a possible 180-day extension. No immediate delisting effect; operations continue. This is a routine disclosure of a listing standard deficiency, not a special situation event.
